concept: Budgets + cost allocation tags: forecast alerts and per-project cost tracking
tests: The combination for alerting on a forecasted budget overrun and breaking down spend by project.
expected: AWS Budgets with forecasted-cost alerts + activate cost allocation tags in the Billing console (breakdown in Cost Explorer/Budgets). Triggers: "forecasted to exceed", "threshold", "track spend by project using tags".
why_not: CloudWatch billing alarms — total actual spend only, no forecast or tags; Trusted Advisor and Compute Optimizer — recommendations, not budgets.
